name: remotive
description: Remotive is a remote-job board. This CLI searches and filters remote job listings, lists facet values such as categories, job types, seniority levels and locations, opens job detail pages, and lists the site's browse-index pages.

commands.name: get-job
commands.summary: Get one remote job posting's detail page by its category slug and job slug (the slug ends in the numeric job id).

params.name: category
params.description: Category slug from the job URL, e.g. 'software-development'

params.name: slug
params.description: Job slug including the trailing id, e.g. 'python-developer-6288354'

commands.name: list-job-index-pages
commands.summary: List Remotive's browse pages for jobs by category, location, employment type, career level and posting date, e.g. /remote-jobs/l-germany, /remote-jobs/cl-senior, /remote-jobs/posted-last-24h.

notes: search-jobs puts each filter into facetFilters as 'field:value'. Leave a filter out to skip it. Filter values must match the facet values from list-job-facets exactly, e.g. category 'Software Development', job_type 'full-time'. The seniority and location values were inferred from UI labels.
search-jobs pages are zero-based and return 35 hits each. The explorer never loaded page 2, so pagination is untested.
Anonymous requests go through a paywall profile ('paywallProfile: custom'). Without logging in, some listings or details may be hidden or limited.
Job detail URLs look like /remote/jobs/{category-slug}/{title-slug}-{id}. Take the url or slug from search-jobs hits and pass it to get-job.
robots.txt disallows the /remote-jobs/* pages and the public JSON API at /api/remote-jobs, so this CLI doesn't use them.
Skipped: /api/my/auth-status (session check) and sa.remotive.com/append (analytics). Saving jobs and filtering by posted date, salary, skills, language or company were not recorded.

params.name: category
params.description: Job category facet value, exactly as returned by list-job-facets (facets.category), e.g. 'Software Development'

params.name: location_mode
params.description: How the location filter matches. 'open' = jobs available from the location, including region-wide or Worldwide jobs. 'listed' = only jobs that explicitly name the location.
